description: This file defines a centralized mock function type for use with Vitest test harness modules under the `src/` directory. It exports a type alias `MockFn` that extends the Vitest `Mock` type, with an explicit generic for function types to prevent exporting inferred `vi.fn()` types.

ctags.name: MockFn
ctags.pattern: /^export type MockFn<T extends (...args: any[]) => any = (...args: any[]) => any> =$/
